H6504.d: 1) to separate, divide; 1a) (Qal) to divide; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to divide, separate; 1b2) to be divided, be separated; 1c) (Piel) to be separated; 1d) (Pual) to be divided; 1e) (Hiphil); 1e1) to divide, separate; 1e2) to make a division, make a separation; 1f) (Hithpael) to be divided, be separated, get separated; Aramaic equivalent: be.dar (בְּדַר "to scatter" H0921)

H6547.d: A man of the Egyptians living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.12.15; § Pharaoh = "great house"; the common title of the king of Egypt

H6522.d: Someone descended from Periz(?), first mentioned at Gen.13.7 ; § Perizzite = "belonging to a village"; a people who inhabited southern Canaan prior to the conquest

H6524.d: 1) to bud, sprout, shoot, bloom; 1a) (Qal) to bud, sprout, send out shoots, blossom; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to cause to bud or sprout; 1b2) to show buds or sprouts

H6541.d: 1) hoof; 1a) of ruminants; 1b) of horses (undivided hooves)

H6536.d: 1) to divide, break in two; 1a) (Qal) to break, break up; 1b) (Hiphil) to be divided (of hoofs); Aramaic equivalent: pe.ras (פְּרַס "to divide" H6537A)

H6538.d: 1) bird of prey; 1a) perhaps bearded vulture or ossifrage; 1b) perhaps an extinct animal, exact meaning unknown

H6593.d: 1) flax, linen; 1a) fibre used as material for garments

H6528.d: 1) the broken off, something scattered; 1a) fallen grapes

H6567.d: 1) to make distinct, declare, distinguish, separate; 1a) (Qal) to declare, clarify; 1b) (Pual) to be distinctly declared; Aramaic equivalent: pe.rash (פְּרַשׁ "to make clear" H6568)

H6545.d: 1) hair, long hair (of head), locks; 2) leader

H6558.d: Someone descended from Perez who was a man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.38.29; ; son of: Judah (H3063) and Tamar (H8559); ; brother of: Zerah (H2226I); ; half-brother of: Er (H6147), Onan (H0209) and Shelah (H7956); ; father of: Hezron (H2696H) and Hamul (H2538); Group of pe.rets (פֶּ֫רֶץ "Perez" H6557) ; § Pharzites, of Pharez "breach"; the descendants of Pharez, the son of Judah by Tamar

H6535.d: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.34.25; ; father of: Elizaphan (H0469H) ; § Parnach = "delicate"; father of Elizaphan, prince of the tribe of Zebulun chosen to help apportion the promised land between the tribes

H6521.d: 1) villager, rural dweller, hamlet-dweller; 2) (TWOT) open region

H6586.d: 1) to rebel, transgress, revolt; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to rebel, revolt; 1a2) to transgress; 1b) (Niphal) to be rebelled against

H6596.d: 1) sockets, hinges, secret parts (meaning uncertain); 1a) sockets; 1b) secret parts

H6559.d: § Perazim = "breaches"; a mountain in Palestine; possibly the same as 'Baal-perazim' which was the scene of a victory of David over the Philistines located in the valley of Rephaim, south of Jerusalem, on the road to Bethlehem

H6583.d: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.9.12; ; son of: Malchijah (H4441H); ; father of: Zechariah (H2148X); § Pashur = "freedom"; 1) a priest, son of Malchiah and one of the chief princes in the reign of king Zedekiah of Judah; 2) a priest, son of Immer, chief governor of the temple, and the one who struck and then put the prophet Jeremiah into the stocks in the reign of king Jehoiakim of Judah; 3) son of Malchijah, father of Zechariah, and ancestor of Adaiah who did the work of the temple in the time of Nehemiah. Probably same as 1; 4) father of Gedaliah; probably the same as 1; 5) head of a family of returned exiles

H6548.d: A man of the Egyptians living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at Jer.37.5; Combined with par.oh (פַּרְעֹה "Pharaoh" H6547R) ; § Pharaoh-hophra = "the great house -covering evil"; the Pharaoh of Egypt at the time of the conquest by Nebuchadnezzar

H6582.d: 1) to tear, rip, tear in pieces; 1a) (Piel) to tear in pieces

H6589.d: 1) to part, open wide; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to open wide; 1a2) to be talkative (of the mouth); 1b) (Piel) to open wide

H6539.d: § Persia = "pure" or "splendid"; the empire Persia; encompassed the territory from India on the east to Egypt and Thrace on the west, and included, besides portions of Europe and Africa, the whole of western Asia between the Black Sea, the Caucasus, the Caspian and the Jaxartes on the north, the Arabian desert, the Persian Gulf and the Indian Ocean on the south; Persia proper was bounded on the west by Susiana or Elam, on the north by Media, on the south by the Persian Gulf and on the east by Carmania; Persian, of Persia "pure" or "splendid"

H6519.d: open region, hamlet, unwalled village, open country

H6543.d: Aramaic of pa.ras (פָּרַס "Persia" H6539) ; § Persian, of Persia "pure" or "splendid"; an inhabitant of Persia

H6563.d: parting of ways, breaking in upon, plunder, crossroad

H6599.d: edict, decree; Aramaic equivalent: pit.gam (פִּתְגָם "edict" H6600)

H6502.d: A man living before Israel's Monarchy, only mentioned at Jos.10.3 ; § Piram = "like a wild ass"; the Amorite king of Jarmuth at the time of the conquest

H6520.d: 1) rural population, rustics, rural people, people of unwalled villages; 1a) meaning uncertain

H6553.d: Pirathonite, of Pirathon "princely"; an inhabitant of Pirathon; Another spelling of pir.a.ton (פִּרְעָתוֹן "Pirathon" H6552)

H6552.d: Pirathon = "princely"; a town in Ephraim in the mount of the Amalekite; perhaps modern 'Ferata' located 1.5 miles (2.5 km) south from Jaffa on the road to Nablus; Also named: pir.a.to.ni (פִּרְעָתוֹנִי "Pirathon" H6553)

H6560.d: § Perez-uzza or Perezuzzah = "breach of Uzza"; the place where Uzzah was slain by God for touching the Ark; located close to Jerusalem

H6515.d: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.17; ; father of: Jehoshaphat (H3092H) ; § Paruah = "sprout"; father of Jehoshaphat, Solomon's commissariat officer in Issachar

H6554.d: § Pharpar = "swift"; a stream in the district of Damascus identified with the modern 'Awaj'; rises on the southeast slopes of Mount Hermon and flows into the southernmost lake of Damascus

H6503.d: § Parbar = "open apartment"; a structure or building attached to the west side of Solomon's temple

H6570.d: A man of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.16; ; son of: Machir (H4353) and Maacah (H4601M); ; brother of: Gilead (H1568H), Sheresh (H8329) and Hammolecheth (H4447) ; § Peresh = "dung"; son of Machir by his wife Maachah

H6516.d: § Parvaim = "oriental regions"; a region known for its gold output, perhaps in Arabia

H6568.d: (Pael) to specify, distinguish, make distinct; Aramaic of pa.rash (פָּרַשׁ "to declare" H6567A)

H6572.d: copy; Another spelling of pat.she.gen (פַּתְשֶׁ֫גֶן "copy" H6572B)

H6542.d: Group of pa.ras (פָּרַס "Persia" H6539) ; § Persian, of Persia "pure" or "splendid"; an inhabitant of Persia

H6534.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Est.9.9; ; son of: Haman (H2001); ; brother of: Parshandatha (H6577), Dalphon (H1813), Aspatha (H0630), Poratha (H6334), Adalia (H0118), Aridatha (H0743), Arisai (H0747), Aridai (H0742) and Vaizatha (H2055) ; § Parmashta = "superior"; one of the 10 sons of Haman, the enemy of Mordecai and queen Esther
